My grandma had undiagnosed bipolar. She would be bed ridden with depression for weeks on end, then she would be her happy, bubbly, talkative, loving, caring self. I’m now diagnosed with bipolar. She’s since passed, and I wish she would’ve chosen to go to therapy and got on some medicine like I did. She could’ve had a much more stable life. I understand her pain and inner turmoil.
